## Question

Which conspiratorial allegations circulating on fringe platforms are taken up by U.S. political elites, what do intermediaries do to those allegations on the way, and does a claim's attributed origin change whether the public accepts a politician using it?

## The actual argument

The visual grammar above — the eye, the red thread, the redaction, the shouting — is the object of study, not the method. Conspiratorial claims arrive wrapped in it and are stripped of it somewhere in transit. I call that **laundering**, and I treat it as a mechanism to be tested rather than a label to apply.

Three transformations are coded separately, because they occur independently: the **wording** changes; the **messenger** changes; the **attributed origin** changes. A fourth code, the allegation itself being altered, is not laundering.

## Stages

| Stage | Object | Standing in the literature |
|---|---|---|
| 01 Origin | Allegation appears on a fringe platform | Theorized; crossing point never dated |
| 02 Spread | Intermediaries carry and transform it | Covered computationally; provenance unresolved |
| 03 Uptake | An officeholder endorses or raises it | Competing accounts, unadjudicated |
| 04 Response | The electorate accepts or sanctions the use | Belief measured; acceptability not |

The sequence is a hypothesis tested against alternatives, not a frame every case must satisfy.

## Rival accounts

| Account | Claim |
|---|---|
| Persuasion | Attribution moves acceptance only through belief |
| Partisan usefulness | Acceptance tracks what the claim does for one's side |
| Authenticity | A lying elite reads as authentic where the system looks illegitimate |
| Participatory production | Elites frame, audiences supply evidence, elites amplify |
| Elite-led | Elites and mass media drive; social media supports |

## Papers

| No. | Question | Method |
|---|---|---|
| I | What happens to allegations between fringe and elite? | Outcome-independent claim cohort; transformation coding |
| II | Why these claims and not others? | Claim × elite × week event history; paired process tracing |
| III | Does attributed origin change acceptability independent of belief? | Preregistered 2×2 survey experiment |
